recent_deploys.message: Fix charge span leak in the payment service (#3276)

ground_truth_root_cause: Deploy e01faa1367fa (2026-05-12T14:13:20Z) modified config/security.js and src/middleware/helmet.config.js, tightening the Content-Security-Policy script-src directive to only allow 'self' and nonce-based scripts. This removed the previously allowlisted Stripe domains (https://js.stripe.com, https://static.stripe.com, https://m.stripe.network) from the CSP header. After the deploy took effect at 15:07:57 UTC, every checkout page load blocked the Stripe.js SDK from loading, causing 'Refused to load script' CSP violations and making Stripe.createPaymentMethod undefined, which broke the entire payment flow.
ground_truth_remediation: Immediately roll back deploy e01faa1367fa to restore the previous CSP configuration. This can be done by reverting config/security.js and src/middleware/helmet.config.js to the prior commit (5b738e5f6b1b) and deploying. Alternatively, hotfix by adding 'https://js.stripe.com https://static.stripe.com https://m.stripe.network' to the script-src and frame-src directives in config/security.js and redeploying within 30 minutes. Confirm fix by verifying CSP violation reports drop to zero and checkout conversion rate recovers to baseline ~0.47.
